text: Figure 6.6: Information path for the External Flash Hardware ID Mismatch During the initialization of the external flash driver, the FLS module checks if there is a mismatch between the hardware ID of the external flash device and the corresponding published parameter (1). If there is a mismatch, the module stays uninitialized. An error is reported to the DEM and error status can also be forwarded to upper layers via polling (2). No further reaction is described (error not taken into account at the NVRAM manager level). There is no recovery action.
